articles.title: U.S. warns California about counting some ballots
articles.summary: The U.S. government warned California officials about counting ballots from people it thinks are not citizens.

articles.title: Strong winds spread a fire in California
articles.summary: Strong winds pushed a fire into two California cities, and about 16,000 people had to leave home.

articles.title: Countries are behind on money to protect nature
articles.summary: Countries have raised less than half the money they promised to protect nature.
